events.text: Predecessor Linee celeri dellAdda fast tramway opened from Cimiano to Gorgonzola.

evidence.quote: opened in 1968 from Cimiano up to Gorgonzola

events.text: ET245 rolling stock introduced on the line with its opening.

evidence.quote: which was introduced in 1969 with the opening of the line

events.text: First section from Caiazzo to Cascina Gobba opened.

evidence.quote: The first part of the line , from Caiazzo to Cascina Gobba , was opened on September 1969

events.text: 300/400 Series trains begin delivery and manufacture.

evidence.quote: As the 300/400 Series trains were delivered starting from 1970
The three-doors 300/400 Series trains were manufactured between 1970 and 1981

events.text: Section incorporated into the newly created Metro line.

evidence.quote: After few years , in 1972 , the section was included in the newly born Metro line

events.text: Section extended to Gessate, the present terminus.

evidence.quote: The same section was extended in 1985 up to Gessate

events.text: 350 Series rolling stock introduced with four doors per car.
350 Series production begins in two batches.

evidence.quote: 350 Series trains were produced in 2 batches between 1985 and 1991

events.text: Three experimental 500 Series trains introduced to test inverters.
350 Series production ends after two batches.

events.text: 3000 Series Leonardo trains follow, jointly replacing older stock.
